privacy: Fresh local synthetic fixtures only; no production app/data/screens/logs/volume contents.
limits: Current source review does not execute every possible runtime combination.
Browser emulation is not physical-device or microphone qualification.
Paid providers, audible quality and arbitrary third-party extensions/themes are unqualified.
Full amd64 browser acceptance and native arm64 startup are distinct evidence.
Console/network fault diagnostics remain recorded; zero page errors does not mean zero failed requests.
diagnosticCaution: Console and failed-request entries remain counted, including deliberately injected failures, unavailable providers, synthetic missing avatars, cancellation, restart and lost acknowledgements. No clean-console or clean-network claim.

testOnlyCorrections.fileChooser: CDP traces show Enter completed before first interception acknowledgement. Registering chooser before focus fixes the harness race; native button/input each clicked exactly once. Controlled15+actual12 repeats and full102 pass.
testOnlyCorrections.rootlessFileIO: The image node user owns files in rootless named volumes. Bounded podman-unshare access preserves ownership/mode/inode and rejects paths outside the generated fixture data volume. Full10 lifecycle cases pass.
testOnlyCorrections.promptMeasurement: A traced callback scrolled a disconnected0x0 node after native rendering replaced it. Bounded fresh connected-node scroll plus unchanged viewport/contrast assertions pass8 repeats and final full28.
testOnlyCorrections.toggleLocator: Original reroll timeout was not reproduced and its cause remains unconfirmed. Final tests use current keyed input locators across native redraws. One intermediate inspector query matched both a label and input; narrowing to the original inputs-only domain corrects that harness error. Full28 then passes.
